paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, “Laigelhna pek lianpi la inla, mihing laigelhna in atung ah Mahershalalhashbaz a ding, chi in gelh in.
heading: Isai Tapa, Mite Lak A Chiamtehna
english: Yahweh said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz; “Maher Shalal Hash Baz” means “quick to the plunder, swift to the spoil.” ’

paite: Huchi in theipih muanhuai, siampu Uriah leh Jaberekiah tapa Zekariah theihpihpa ding in ka bawl ding," achi hi.
english: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”

paite: Huan zawlneinu kiang ah ka hoh a, huchi in ama'n nau apai a, tapa aneita hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Amin in Mahershalalhashbaz sa in.
english: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then Yahweh said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’

paite: Naupang in, Nu, Pa, chihna dan atheih ma in leng Damaskas hauhsakna leh Samaria a gallak tengteng Assuria kumpipa ma ah apaimangpih ding uh," achi hi.
english: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father,’ and, ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah agen nawn a,
heading: Assuria Kumpipa Ahong Tung
english: Yahweh spoke to me yet again, saying,

paite: "Hiai chite'n Shiloah tui awl a luang diahdiah adeih louh ziak un leh Rezin leh Remaliah tapa tung a akipah un,
english: “Because this people have refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;

paite: huaiziak in tu in, ngai in, Toupa'n luipi tui, khauh mahmah leh tam mahmah, Assuria kumpipa leh athupina tengteng, atung uah aluangsak ding; huchi in apiau tengteng a hong let zoizoi in, agei tengteng ah leng alet zoizoi ding;
english: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.

paite: huchi in Judah gam tuam in aluang ding a; ngawng tan atum pha hial ding a; akha zak in, Immanuel aw, na gam vailam tengteng akhak vek ding hi.
english: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through; it will reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of its wings will fill the breadth of your land, Immanuel.

paite: Chichihte aw, buai vengvungta unla, kitamzak a om ding na hi uhi; gam gamlapi a mi tengteng aw, bildoh un; kigalthuam un, kitamzak a om ding na hi uhi; kigalthuam un, kitamzak a om ding na hi uhi.
english: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!

paite: Thu kikum unla, bangmah hi peuh ke'n teh; thu gen unla, piching peuh ke'n teh; Pathian i kiang ah a-om ngal a," chi in.
english: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand: for God is with us.”

paite: TOUPA'N khut hattak in huchi in ka kiang ah agen, hiai chite lampi a ka pailouhna ding in hon thuzoh ei ve;
heading: TOUPA'N Zawlnei Avauhilh
english: For Yahweh spoke thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,

paite: Hiai chite'n, "Sawm anei uh, achih teng uh, Sawm anei uh, chihpih kei un, akihtak teng uh zong nou zaw kihta kei unla, lau leng laupih sam kei un.
english: “Don’t say, ‘A conspiracy!’ concerning all about which this people say, ‘A conspiracy!’ neither fear their threats, nor be terrorized.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, amah mah na hihsiangthou ding uhi; amah na kihtak uh hi henla, amah na lauh uh hi hen.
english: Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.

paite: Huan amah mun siangthou a ding ahi ding a; Israel inkuanpih nihte a ding in bel pukna suang leh dalna suangpi ahi zaw ding a, Jerusalem a omte a ding in thang leh pial ahi lai ding hi.
english: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a trap and a snare for the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in mi tampi in huai asui ding ua apuk ding uh, kitapsak in a-om ding ua, a-awk ding ua, mat in a-om ding uh," chi in.
english: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”

paite: Theihsakna thu zial gak inla, dan thu ka sinsakte lak ah bilh in.
heading: Misite Dotna Thu A Vauhilhna
english: Wrap up the testimony. Seal the law among my disciples.

paite: Huan ke'n Jakob inkuanpihte lak a amai selpa TOUPA ka ngak ding a, amah ka en nilouh ding.
english: I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

paite: Ngai in, kei leh TOUPA hon piak naupangte, Israelte lak ah sepaihte' TOUPA Zion tang a om lak a chiamtehna a dingte leh thillamdang a dingte i hi uhi.
english: Behold, I and the children whom Yahweh has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from Yahweh of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.

paite: Huan mi'n, "Dawi aisan siam zawl leh bumsiam ham tualtual leh phun nomnomte dong in, ahon chih chiang un huchi in dawng un; Mi'n a Pathian uh adot zawk ding uh hilou hia? Mihingte a ding in misi adong ding ua hia?"
english: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter:” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?

paite: "Dan thu leh theihsakna thu dot ding ahi," chi in. Huai thu bangbang a agen kei uleh amaute a ding in khua himhim avak zok kei ding hi.
english: Turn to the law and to the testimony! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.

paite: Lungkhamtak leh gilkial kawm in gam atuansuak ding ua; hichi ahi ding a, agil uh akial chiang in aheh mahmah ding ua, akumpipa uleh a Pathian uh ahamsiat ding ua, van lam anga ding uhi.
heading: Buaina Hun
english: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry; and it will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse by their king and by their God. They will turn their faces upward,

paite: Huchi in lei lam a-en ding ua, ngai in, lungkhamna leh mialna, lunglauna nguina ahi ding; huchi in mial bikbek ah delhmang in a-om ding uh.
english: and look to the earth, and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.
